primary.title: Ninety-five Theses
primary.author: Martin Luther
primary.rationale: The foundational document of the Protestant Reformation, widely translated and available.

primary.title: On the Freedom of a Christian
primary.author: Martin Luther
primary.rationale: A key theological work outlining Luther's understanding of Christian liberty, available in translation.

primary.title: Table Talk
primary.author: Martin Luther
primary.rationale: A collection of Luther's reported conversations and sayings, offering insights into his thought and life. Compiled posthumously.

secondary.title: Martin Luther: A Life
secondary.author: James M. Kittelson
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive and well-regarded scholarly biography of Martin Luther.

secondary.title: The Cambridge Companion to Martin Luther
secondary.author: Donald K. McKim
secondary.rationale: A collection of essays by leading scholars covering various aspects of Luther's life, theology, and impact.

secondary.title: Luther's Works
secondary.author: Jaroslav Pelikan and Helmut T. Lehmann
secondary.rationale: While the publication started before 1976, this multi-volume collection is the standard English edition of Luther's writings and essential for scholarly research. Many volumes are available digitally.

suggestions.notes: The 'Luther's Works' entry is included as a foundational secondary resource despite its earlier start date due to its unparalleled importance in Luther scholarship. Many individual volumes and related scholarly analyses are available from 1976 onwards.
